steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: RAW files contain far more data than JPEGs — they allow greater adjustment in post-processing without quality loss. | Key Fact: Levels and curves control tonal range and contrast; colour balance adjusts warmth/coolness across the image. | Key Fact: Dodging (lightening) and burning (darkening) specific areas directs the viewer's attention — used by photographers since the darkroom era. | Key Fact: Ethical considerations: photojournalism requires minimal manipulation; fine art photography allows creative transformation — know the boundaries of your genre.
